subject: general
question: In 1680, ________, son of Chhatrapati Shivaji, ascended the throne after winning a war of succession against his brother Rajaram.
solution:
The correct answer is **Chhatrapati** __**Sambhaji.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **After the death of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the struggle of Uttarakar started in the Maratha Empire.**
 
• **In the struggle, the eldest son Chhatrapati Sambhaji defeated Anuj Rajaram and got power.**
 
• He created a crisis for himself by providing shelter to Akbar II, the rebellious son of Aurangzeb.
 
• He re-implemented his father's expansionist policies to avert the Rajput-Maratha alliance and to re-establish his old ties with the Deccan Sultanate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **After the death of Shambaji, Shivaji's second son Rajaram took over the rule **and carried forward the Maratha tradition.
 
• He continued the expansionist policy of the Marathas and started the tradition of invading the Mughal territories of the Deccan.
 
• **After Rajaram's death, his widow Tarabai placed her son Shivaji II on the throne** and herself became his protector. She provided stability to the Maratha state in times of crisis, both in civil and military terms.
